Marketing

Launch Product

ct-marketing-launch-product

Prepare product launch assets and measurement, then publish only explicitly authorized assets with duplicate prevention and live readback. Use for launch preparation or execution, not market discovery.

Install this skill

Use the public repository's installer. You need Git and Python 3.10 or newer. The commands below install only ct-marketing-launch-product for the agent you choose.

1. Get the repository once

Run this in a terminal. If you already have this checkout, open it and update your clean local copy instead of cloning again.

Repository setup
git clone https://github.com/Ginylil/context-templates.git
cd context-templates

Select and copy the text, or use the Copy button.

On Windows, use python or py -3 instead of python3 if that is how Python is installed.
